cli.usage_wpp_global_options_command_com.en:
Usage: wpp [global options] <command>
Commands: login, chats [--groups], track <id>, untrack <id>, run, status, export, serve, audio status|retry <source>, audio correct <source> <transcript.json>, language [en|pt-BR]
JSONL events: events next|status <group>, events ack <group> <batch>
Offline JSONL: events next|status <group>, events ack <group> <batch>, evidence <group> <source>; batch is an alias for events
cli.usage_wpp_global_options_command_com.pt-BR:
Uso: wpp [opções globais] <comando>
Comandos: login, chats [--groups], track <id>, untrack <id>, run, status, export, serve, audio status|retry <fonte>, audio correct <fonte> <transcricao.json>, language [en|pt-BR]
Eventos JSONL: events next|status <grupo>, events ack <grupo> <lote>
JSONL offline: events next|status <grupo>, events ack <grupo> <lote>, evidence <grupo> <fonte>; batch é alias de events
